prompt:
Subject: sheath, target meaning "鞘".

Composition: A polished sword slides halfway into a fitted leather scabbard held in one gloved hand. Make the protective sheath, its opening, and the partially covered blade unmistakable.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands, with no duplicate limbs.
en: A leather sheath protects a sword as it slides halfway inside.
ja: 革の鞘が剣を覆い、刃が半分ほど収まっています。
